description_en: Queries the details of a schema synchronization ticket
description_zh: 调用GetStructSyncOrderDetail获取结构同步的工单详情信息
name: GetStructSyncOrderDetail

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the tenant ID, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

StructSyncOrderDetail.description_en: The details of the schema synchronization ticket

IgnoreError.description_en:
Indicates whether to skip errors. Valid values:

true: skips the error and continues to execute SQL statements.
false: stops executing SQL statements
IgnoreError.description_zh:
是否忽略报错，取值：
true：忽略，遇到错误会跳过当前失败SQL脚本，继续执行。
false：不忽略，遇到出错则中断后面的SQL脚本，不再执行

DbType.description_en: The type of the database engine

EnvType.description_en: The type of the environment to which the database instance belongs. For more information, see [Change the environment type of an instance]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html）
EnvType.description_zh: 实例的环境类型，更多信息，请参见[实例环境说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163309.html）

Logic.description_en:
Indicates whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

true: The database is a logical database.
false: The database is not a logical database
Logic.description_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值：
true：是
false：否

SearchName.description_en: The name that is used to search for the database

SourceType.description_en:
The schema version of the source database. Valid values:

DATASOURCE: the default latest version of the system
VERSION: a previous schema version that you manually specify
SourceType.description_zh:
表结构类型，取值和说明如下：
DATASOURCE：系统默认的最新版。
VERSION：手动输入的历史版本

SourceVersionInfo.description_en:
The version information about the source instance.

This parameter is displayed only when the value of the SourceType parameter is VERSION

源版本信息。
